statement: For every cutoff N, every v : ℕ → ℂ and every real D, with k_n = 2^n, S = sum_{n<N+2}|v_n|^2, E = S/2, Omega = 1/2 sum_{n<N+2} k_n^2|v_n|^2, H3 = sum_{n<N+2} 2^-n D k_n^3 |v_n|^2 + sum_{n<N+1} 2^-n k_n Im(conj(v_n)^2 v_{n+1}): 2 D Omega <= H3 + (2E)^(3/2) (Real.rpow).
